description: Sleep plausibility on four nights (UTC): a 36-min partial session is suspect (absent, never a short night); a 6 h night plus a 30-min nap stays 6 h (the nap is outside the night window); a valid 5h30 night is SHORT_SLEEP and blocks quality; a fragmented night (4 h + 3 h gap) keeps only the largest 4 h block and blocks quality. Every case runs the validator, the aggregator, the readiness calculator with a 4/2/2/2 check-in and the day quality gate on a passing load.
